messages:
Tara Millar: Quick check-in on the Mar10 token-ingest discrepancy. We need tight owners for remediation, invoice corrections, and customer outreach.
Sanjay Patel: I will take engineering owner for the consumer fix and orchestrate the backfill. Plan: canary in 24h, full roll in 48h. Backfill will run in small windows.
Alex Chen: Billing ops will need the exact invoice ids and token deltas. I can generate a provisional credit CSV after Sanjay provides seq ranges.
Julie Park: I'll draft comms buckets: small (<$200), mid ($200-$5k), large (>$5k). Large accounts get CSM + exec note.
Maria Gomez: I'll own the postmortem doc and the exec summary. Also creating an epic for recurring ingestion failures (INGEST-TRIAGE).
billing-bot: Incident INC-4723 logged (severity: P2) (tagged: finance, eng).
Sanjay Patel: Risk: backfill could cause transient CPU spikes. Mitigation: dry-run + throttles + monitoring.
Alex Chen: CSV format: invoice_id, customer_id, tokens_before, tokens_after, token_delta, suggested_credit_usd, incident_id. Will tag journals with INCIDENT=INC-4723.
Tara Millar: Escrow credits idea accepted — support can issue provisional credits pending audit; TTL 21 days and 2-person approval >$500.
Julie Park: Support playbook ready once Alex shares numbers. We'll hold public comms until top-10 customers are reviewed.
Maria Gomez: Confirmed owners: Sanjay (eng/backfill), Alex (invoices/credits), Julie (comms), Tara (escrow policy), Maria (postmortem). 30min sync tomorrow 11:00am PT.
All: Ack.
